answer: A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, because the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the gale band is published for each class. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 151 to 248 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the canyon identity is graded at all. Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the raven audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
